o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish ویرمك (vẹrmek), from Proto-Turkic *bēr- (“to give”). Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (ber-, “to give”), Turkish vermek, etc. For the sense 3, compare Turkish vermek and Russian дать (datʹ).
From Georgian ბიჭი (bič̣i) or from an Iranian source.
Ultimately from French stratégie, reinterpreted as an adjective.
Univerbation of qanuna + uyğun. Calque of Russian закономе́рный (zakonomérnyj).
